gloss: formal report; official reply to an inquiry

definitions.gloss: formal report; official reply to an inquiry
definitions.explanation: A formal report or recommendation that an advisory body returns in response to a {諮問|しもん} (official inquiry), especially in government or institutional settings.

examples.japanese: {審議会|しんぎかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{答申|とうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: The council issued a formal report.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{答申|とうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尊重|そんちょう}する→尊重する：17456_sonchousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: The minister said he would respect the content of the report.

examples.japanese: ⟦{諮問|しもん}→諮問：17729_shimon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧{答申|とうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: The committee that had received the inquiry compiled its report after half a year of discussion.

notes:
Used in governmental and institutional settings. The typical process is: an authority ⟦{諮問|しもん}→諮問：17729_shimon⟧s (consults) an advisory body, which then produces a {答申|とうしん} (formal report) in reply.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {答申|とうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to issue a report
- {答申|とうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a report
- {答申|とうしん}⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧: a draft report

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{諮問|しもん}→諮問：17729_shimon⟧: official inquiry — the consultation that a {答申|とうしん} responds to
- ⟦{報告|ほうこく}{書|しょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧: report — a general written report, not tied to a formal inquiry
